about_the_game:
What must a chef entrusted with starting a new restaurant in London do? That's right, prepare a menu and come up with a name for the place. Except you've almost missed the deadline. Being out of ideas, you felt super-lucky to see an email offering to solve your exact problem. You clicked on the attached link, and then… Welcome to Wonderland's one and only mobile cafe. A long journey awaits you in the unpleasant company of the smug Cat. Fingers crossed, you'll find a way back home. But firstly, you have to feed the locals. Yet they are eccentric, capricious in their tastes, and tend to interfere in your cooking.

Wonderland cooking courses offer you:

  • To find proper recipes for ordered dishes. Each visitor's order has a hint on what ingredients and tools to use. The rest is up to you. Explore.

  • To satisfy your weird visitors. A hungry guest is an angry guest.

  • To meet and serve special guests with special requests that you can fulfil only with cards received from satisfied visitors.

  • To manage ingredient stock: buy more cooking cards, sell the excess, and grow new ingredients by planting seedlings on your farm.

  • To upgrade your decks of cooking cards and tools.

  • To feed bosses with unbridled appetites.

  • To complete 25+ levels where you can experiment with recipes. Cook meals you dreamed of, from salads to fried dishes.

  • To cook more. To meet timers, and finally come back to London with a pile of ideas for your own menu.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS *: Windows 7, 8, 10 64 bit
  • Processor: Core i3 6xxx or better
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GeForce GTX 750
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 500 MB available space

short_description: Abra-Cooking-Dabra is a cooking card game. Manage ingredients and make British dishes to keep toves, borogoves, and mome raths fed. Meet timers and fulfill puzzling orders despite the angry wacky Cat being your boss. You are Wonderland's new chef.
supported_languages:
English*, Russian
*languages with full audio support
